title: Accounts Payable Assistant
description:
Accounts Payable Assistant

Location: Filton
Contract: 6 Months
Rate: £18.61 per hour PAYE
Working Pattern: Fully On-Site

About the Role

Morson are recruiting on behalf of GKN Aerospace for an Accounts Payable Assistant to join their Finance team in Filton on a 6-month contract.

The role will support the Accounts Payable function, processing a high volume of invoices and resolving queries and exceptions to ensure invoices are cleared for payment within agreed terms.

- Using the invoice Action Centre to resolve scanning and data issues.
- Completing regular supplier statement reconciliations.
- Communicating with suppliers and internal stakeholders by telephone and email to resolve invoice queries.

About You
- Previous experience working within an Accounts Payable function is essential.
- Strong numeracy skills with a good grounding in accounting or bookkeeping.
- Experience managing a high volume of invoices or an invoice backlog.
- Good communication skills with the ability to liaise across different functions and at all levels.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Experience using SAP or Tradeshift would be beneficial but is not essential.
- Experience working within a fast-paced manufacturing environment would be advantageous.

This is a great opportunity to join GKN Aerospace on a 6-month contract and gain experience within a leading aerospace organisation. If you have the relevant Accounts Payable experience and are interested in the position, please apply today.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

This is a great opportunity to join an established business on a temp-to-perm basis, offering a varied Credit Control position within a supportive finance team.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Location: Gloucester
Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract, with a strong possibility of becoming permanent
Hours: 40 hours per week
Working pattern: Fully office-based

The Opportunity

An opportunity has arisen for an experienced Credit Controller to join a busy finance team on an initial 6-month fixed-term contract, with a strong possibility of the position becoming permanent.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone confident managing customer accounts, chasing outstanding payments and maintaining strong working relationships. You will take ownership of an allocated ledger, proactively manage overdue balances and work closely with internal teams to resolve queries and improve cash collection.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage an allocated portfolio of customer accounts, monitoring outstanding balances and ensuring debts are actively chased.
- Make a high volume of outbound calls to customers to follow up overdue invoices and secure payment.
- Prioritise accounts based on outstanding values, age of debt and payment risk.
- Maintain regular contact with customers, confirming agreed payment dates and following up in writing.
- Investigate unallocated and short payments, working with customers and internal teams to resolve discrepancies.
- Identify potential bad debt and highlight accounts requiring further attention.
- Identify and record invoice disputes, ensuring these are passed to the relevant internal teams for resolution.
- Monitor outstanding queries and resume collection activity promptly once resolved.
- Maintain accurate records of customer communications, payment activity and account updates.
- Support payment allocation when required.

About You
- Previous experience in Credit Control, Accounts Receivable or Sales Ledger.
- Comfortable making high volumes of outbound calls within a B2 B environment.
- Confident handling difficult conversations and chasing payments assertively but professionally.
- Good understanding of credit control processes and payment terms.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Experience using finance systems and Microsoft Excel.
- Highly organised, proactive and able to manage a busy workload independently.
- Resilient, self-motivated and target-driven, with a strong approach to debt recovery.

title: Finance Assistant
description:

Hays Accountancy & Finance are partnering exclusively with a growing and forward-thinking finance services organisation based in Cheltenham, Gloucestershire to recruit an experienced permanent Finance Assistant. This is an exciting opportunity to join a progressive business that provides high-quality finance support to a varied portfolio of growing organisations. You will work as part of a collaborative client services team, gaining exposure to different businesses while helping clients improve their financial processes, systems and ways of working.

The organisation embraces technology, automation and continuous improvement, making this an excellent opportunity for an experienced Finance Assistant who enjoys working in a fast-paced, modern finance environment. The position offers remote/office hybrid working of 2 days on-site, 3 days remote, flexible working hours, company/personal annual bonus scheme, development opportunities, study package for AAT if applicable, private healthcare and more.

Your new role:

Reporting to the wider client services team, you will work directly with a portfolio of clients, ensuring accurate financial records are maintained while supporting the implementation and improvement of processes and technology.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Processing sales transactions from sales order through to invoicing and receipt, ensuring a high level of accuracy.
- Processing purchase transactions from requisition and purchase order through to invoice and payment.
- Working as part of the client engagement team to support the onboarding of new clients.
- Supporting the implementation of standardised finance processes and automation tools.
- Building strong working relationships with clients to ensure the correct information is obtained and transactions are processed accurately.
- Helping clients adopt new processes, systems and ways of working.
- Working with the wider team to identify and implement improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency and the overall service delivered to clients.

What you'll need to succeed:
To be considered for this hands-on Finance Assistant position, you will ideally be AAT qualified or equivalent, with practical transactional finance experience.
- Previous experience using accounting software such as Xero and/or Sage.
- Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills.
- A good understanding of sales and purchase ledger processes.
- Experience or confidence in using AI-based tools and automation to improve finance processes, reconciliations, data entry or reporting.
- Strong attention to detail with a process-driven approach.
- The ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain financial information clearly.
- Strong organisation and time-management skills.
- A proactive and adaptable approach with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and changing environment.
- A genuine interest in continuous improvement, technology and developing more efficient ways of working.
- Multi-client experience would be advantageous but not essential.

You will be a collaborative and commercially minded individual who enjoys building trusted relationships with both clients and colleagues. You will take ownership of your work, be comfortable working at pace and enjoy being part of a growing organisation.

What you'll get in return

This permanent Finance Assistant position offers the opportunity to join an ambitious and growing finance services organisation in Cheltenham, Gloucestershire with exposure to a diverse portfolio of clients and businesses. Salary of 28,000 - 34,000 per annum, dependable on experience with up to a 10 % personal/company annual bonus.

The role offers a flexible working arrangement of two days on-site, three days remote, flexible working hours, private health care, critical illness cover, group income protection, development opportunities, study package for AAT if required and more. It is an excellent opportunity if you are looking to join a modern environment where technology, automation, client service and continuous improvement are central to the organisation.

title: Junior Accounts Assistant
description:
Junior Accounts Assistant

Cheltenham, Gloucestershire Full Training Provided Career Development Opportunity

Looking to start or build your career in accounts and administration? Join a successful business with a professional, friendly team based at its Cheltenham Head Office. This is an excellent opportunity for a Junior Accounts Assistant to gain hands-on experience, receive full training, and develop valuable skills within a unique and exciting industry.

Benefits
- Full training provided on SAGE and company processes
- Career development and progression opportunities
- Supportive and experienced Accounts team
- Exposure to both accounts and office administration
- Friendly and professional working environment
- Permanent, full-time opportunity
- Modern Cheltenham Head Office location
- Opportunity to develop skills within the aviation sector

The Role

As a Junior Accounts Assistant, you'll play an important part in supporting the Accounts Department and wider business. No two days will be exactly the same. You'll spend time processing financial documents, maintaining accurate records, assisting with invoice management, and supporting the day-to-day administration of a busy office.

Reporting to the Accounts Manager and Senior Accounts Team, your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices and credit notes using SAGE
- Scanning, filing and maintaining accurate electronic records
- Assisting with the preparation and processing of sales invoices
- Supporting supplier statement reconciliations
- Cross-referencing accounting documents and records
- Answering incoming telephone calls and directing enquiries
- Managing filing, document control and general administration tasks
- Assisting with incoming and outgoing post
- Ordering stationery and maintaining office supplies
- Supporting meeting room preparation and visitor hospitality
- Assisting with office organisation and day-to-day housekeeping
- Providing administrative support to the wider Accounts team as required

This Junior Accounts Assistant role offers excellent exposure to both finance and business administration, making it an ideal first step into an accounts career.

Requirements

We're looking for a motivated and organised individual who enjoys working in a team and takes pride in producing accurate work.

To be successful, you'll have:
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
- Good attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and time-management skills
- Good numeracy skills
- A professional and approachable manner
- The ability to manage confidential information appropriately
- Confidence communicating with colleagues, suppliers and customers
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team

Previous accounts or administration experience would be beneficial but is not essential, as full training will be provided.

This would be an ideal opportunity for someone who has been an Administrator, Office Assistant, Receptionist, Accounts Administrator or Administrative Assistant within an office environment and is looking to develop a career in accounts.

About the Business

This well-established aviation business specialises in aircraft management and charter services, operating from its Head Office in Cheltenham and supporting customers across the UK and internationally.

The organisation combines high professional standards with a supportive and collaborative working culture. Due to continued growth and ongoing business needs, the Accounts Department is looking to recruit an enthusiastic and reliable Junior Accounts Assistant who is keen to learn and develop.

You'll receive full training on accounting systems, procedures and processes, with increasing responsibility as your confidence and experience grow. This is a genuine opportunity to build a long-term career in accounts and administration within a specialist sector.

Salary & Package
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience
- Full-time permanent position
- Full training on SAGE accounting software and internal systems
- Structured support from experienced Accounts professionals
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities
- Opportunity to develop long-term accounts and administration skills
- Professional office-based working environment in Cheltenham, Gloucestershire
- Supportive team culture within a successful aviation business

If you're looking for an opportunity to begin or develop your career as a Junior Accounts Assistant in a business that will invest in your development, we'd love to hear from you.
